result.stdout:
Score C# callables using cyclomatic complexity and source-bound coverage

Usage: dotnet-crap [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  [PATHS]...  

Options:
      --root <ROOT>            [default: .]
      --threshold <THRESHOLD>  [default: 10]
      --format <FORMAT>        [default: text] [possible values: text, json, sarif]
      --output <OUTPUT>        
      --coverage <COVERAGE>    
      --require-coverage       
      --fail-on-empty          
      --jobs <N>               Worker threads for scanning [default: available parallelism]
      --define <SYMBOL>        Conditional compilation symbol for files that do not parse as written (repeatable; comma- or semicolon-separated lists are accepted)
      --skip-unparsed          Skip files that still do not parse instead of failing the scan
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version

Fresh coverage collection: dotnet-crap collect --help
